story: Messy spreadsheet on a laptop -> the bubble mascot squeegees it -> clean sheet with a lime header -> cheer -> loop. It all happens on the laptop.
caption: Messy CSV in → clean file out

keyframe-clean.png.tool: Higgsfield generate_image gpt_image_2_6, quality high, 16:9, edit of keyframe-messy

picked.why: The squeegee visibly reveals a clean sheet behind it and the clean sheet is held about 2 s. Its last second (a junk sheet sliding over the keyboard) is cut.

rejected.why: Ends on the clean sheet (no loop); the mascot covers the laptop for most of the clip.
Good runner-up (foam burst, clean sheet), but the mascot turns its back and loses the squeegee for half a second.
The sheet never becomes clean, so the product promise is not shown.

web.edit: trim 0-5.8 s, then a 0.6 s dissolve from the end into the start for a seamless loop (scratchpad encode.ps1; ffmpeg 9.0.2 at BelowNormal priority)

files.explainer.mp4: H.264 high, 960x528, 24 fps, 5.2 s, CRF 27, faststart, no audio, 347 KB

takes: takes/*_sheet.jpg are contact sheets (one frame every 0.5 s) of every take, kept for review
